title: VoiceBench: Benchmarking LLM-Based Voice Assistants
claim: First benchmark for LLM-based voice assistants (6,783 spoken instructions, 8 tasks) with accent, environment and mispronunciation variation; reveals limits of current models and an end-to-end vs ASR+LLM gap.
not_covered: No tool calls or executed actions; no entity-level or silent-vs-surfaced scoring; no confirmation lever.

title: AudioBench: A Universal Benchmark for Audio Large Language Models
claim: Universal AudioLLM benchmark: 8 tasks, 26 datasets over speech, audio-scene and paralinguistic understanding; no model dominant.
not_covered: No cascade arm, no tool calls, no entity slots, no acoustic crossing, no confirmation.

title: AHELM: A Holistic Evaluation of Audio-Language Models
claim: Holistic 10-aspect ALM benchmark with standardised prompts; 14 ALMs plus 3 ASR+LM baselines; Gemini 2.5 Pro tops 5/10 but unfair on ASR; one cascade baseline ranks 6th.
not_covered: Cascade baselines scored on QA aspects, not tool arguments; no executed calls, no entity ledger, no levers.

title: VoiceAssistant-Eval: Benchmarking AI Assistants across Listening, Speaking, and Viewing
claim: 10,497 examples over 13 listening/speaking/viewing tasks; 21 open models + GPT-4o-Audio; proprietary not universally better; robustness and safety gaps.
not_covered: End-to-end only; no cascade comparison, tool calls, entity accuracy or confirmation.

title: Hearing to Translate: The Effectiveness of Speech Modality Integration into LLMs
claim: 6 SpeechLLMs vs 16 direct/cascade ST systems over 16 benchmarks and 9 conditions (disfluent, noisy, long-form): cascades most reliable overall, recent SpeechLLMs match or beat them in some settings.
not_covered: Speech translation, not tool calling; no entity silent-error measure; no telephone band; no confirmation.

title: Towards Spoken Mathematical Reasoning: Benchmarking Speech-based Models over Multi-faceted Math Problems
claim: Spoken-MQA benchmark for cascade and end-to-end speech LLMs: speech LLMs struggle with direct arithmetic and verbalised math; knowledge reasoning degrades in speech LLMs.
not_covered: Scores math answers, not spoken amounts carried into tool arguments; no acoustic conditions; no silent-vs-surfaced; no confirmation.

title: A Preliminary Exploration with GPT-4o Voice Mode
claim: GPT-4o audio assessed across tasks: strong intent/command classification and multilingual ASR, more hallucination-robust than other LALMs; refusals vary by dataset.
not_covered: No cascade comparison, tool calls, entity/number accuracy, controlled acoustics or levers.

title: GlobeAudio: A Multilingual Multicultural Benchmark for Naturalistic Evaluation of Large Audio-Language Models
claim: 5,637 native-speaker MCQs in six languages on natural audio; LALMs and cascaded ASR-LLM pipelines evaluated; large gaps under natural acoustics.
not_covered: MCQ understanding; no tool calls, entity slots, telephone band or confirmation.

title: VoiceAgentBench: Are Voice Assistants ready for agentic tasks?
claim: 6,000+ spoken agentic queries (single/multi-tool, multi-turn, safety) in English and 6 Indic languages with speaker diversity; ASR-LLM pipelines beat end-to-end SpeechLMs (up to 60.6% parameter-filling accuracy).
not_covered: Parameter accuracy not broken down by entity type or silent-vs-asked; no noise/rate/telephone crossing; no confirmation or gating lever.

title: From Text to Voice: A Reproducible and Verifiable Framework for Evaluating Tool Calling LLM Agents
claim: Converts text tool-calling benchmarks to audio via TTS, speaker variation and noise; 7 omni models; text-to-voice gap 1.8-4.8 points; failures mostly argument-value misunderstandings from speech.
not_covered: Omni models only (no Whisper cascade or audio-LLM-transcriber arm); no executed silent-wrong ledger by entity type; no telephone band; no confirmation, gating or ask-when-unsure lever.

title: Audio2Tool: Speak, Call, Act - A Dataset for Benchmarking Speech Tool Use
claim: ~30k spoken tool-calling queries (Smart Car/Home/Wearables) with complexity tiers, voice-cloned TTS and noise; SpeechLMs and ASR-LLM pipelines degrade under compositional and acoustic challenge.
not_covered: Device-command domains without high-stakes numeric entities; correctness not classified silent-vs-surfaced; no telephone band; no confirmation.

title: Full-Duplex-Bench-v3: Benchmarking Tool Use for Full-Duplex Voice Agents Under Real-World Disfluency
claim: Real disfluent human audio with chained API calls; six configurations incl. a Whisper->GPT-4o cascade; GPT-Realtime leads Pass@1 0.600; cascade slowest (10.12 s); self-correction and multi-step reasoning are the main failures.
not_covered: Scenario Pass@1, not per-entity argument ledger; disfluency rather than accent/noise/telephone crossing; no confirmation lever.

title: τ-Voice: Benchmarking Full-Duplex Voice Agents on Real-World Domains
claim: tau^2-bench extended to full-duplex voice with accents and audio environments; voice agents reach 31-51% clean and 26-38% noisy vs 85% text; 79-90% of failures are agent behaviour.
not_covered: Task pass@1, not entity-level silent-wrong; no Whisper cascade arm in abstract; no isolated confirmation lever; no telephone band.

title: EVA-Bench: A New End-to-end Framework for Evaluating Voice Agents
claim: Bot-to-bot audio simulation with EVA-A/EVA-X metrics, 213 enterprise scenarios, accent-and-noise perturbation suite, multi-trial reliability; 12 systems across 3 architectures; perturbation effects vary by architecture.
not_covered: Perturbation x architecture at scenario level, not per entity; entity attention is on output speech fidelity; no confirmation lever isolated; no telephone band.

title: MTVA-Bench: Evaluating the Language Model Inside Cascaded Voice Agents
claim: Evaluates the LM inside cascaded voice agents with an LLM caller and a mock backend that responds to arguments actually sent; 490 scenarios, 7 languages; tool choice similar across models but argument values, ordering and rule compliance drive a 24.4-point spread.
not_covered: Cascade-only with text-simulated transcription issues; no audio pipeline factor; no silent-vs-surfaced classification; no acoustic conditions; no confirmation recovery.

title: Audio MultiChallenge: A Multi-Turn Evaluation of Spoken Dialogue Systems on Natural Human Interaction
claim: 452 unscripted multi-turn conversations with Voice Editing and Audio-Cue axes; best model 54.65% pass; self-coherence degrades with longer audio.
not_covered: Dialogue rubrics, not tool execution; no cascade arm, entity ledger, acoustics or confirmation.

title: A frontend-backend architecture for tool calls in full-duplex speech models
claim: Duplex speech frontend delegates to a text backend LLM for tool calls via streaming ASR; 92-97% tool-call recall; competitive on FDB-v3 and EVA-Bench.
not_covered: System proposal, not a silent-wrong measurement; no entity-type ledger, acoustic crossing or confirmation.

title: CORTIS: Text-Only Adaptation of Spoken Language Models for Task-Oriented Voice Agents
claim: Text-only adaptation of Qwen2.5-Omni for structured outputs; competitive with matched ASR-LLM cascades and better under acoustic degradation, especially on high-level task semantics.
not_covered: Training method; frame/action accuracy without silent-vs-errored separation or per-entity rates; no telephone band; no confirmation.

title: Speech-based Slot Filling using Large Language Models
claim: LLM slot filling on noisy ASR transcripts (SLURP) via ICL and fine-tuning with knowledge injection; +8.3 SLU-F1 for LLaMA-13B.
not_covered: Cascade-only SLU-F1; no audio-native arm; no acoustic crossing; no executed calls or confirmation.

title: The Speech-LLM Takes It All: A Truly Fully End-to-End Spoken Dialogue State Tracking Approach
claim: End-to-end spoken DST with Speech-LLMs: full spoken history as input gives best JGA on SpokenWOZ; attention-pooled compression is a good trade-off.
not_covered: DST JGA, not tool execution; no cascade crossing, acoustics, silent-vs-surfaced or confirmation.

title: AVERT: Audio-Verified Adjudication for Spoken Dialogue State Tracking
claim: States ASR errors concentrate in entity values in spoken DST; audio-conditioned verifier with vote/add/swap lifts SpokenWOZ JGA 33.04 -> 40.13.
not_covered: Slot values in DST, not executed tool calls; model-side verifier rather than user confirmation; no acoustic crossing; no calibration of asking.

title: SpokenUS: A Spoken User Simulator for Task-Oriented Dialogue
claim: SpokenTOD (52k dialogues) with cross-turn slots, barge-in, disfluency, prosody; SpokenUS simulator discloses slot values gradually like humans.
not_covered: User simulator, not a silent-wrong measurement; no pipeline comparison; no confirmation oracle.

title: LingVarBench: Benchmarking LLMs on Entity Recognitions and Linguistic Verbalization Patterns in Phone-Call Transcripts
claim: Entity extraction (ZIP, DOB, name) from phone-call transcripts with entity-specific readout styles; optimised prompts reach F1 ~94-95% on real calls.
not_covered: Text transcripts only; extraction F1, not executed calls; no ASR/audio-LLM factor; no confirmation.

title: Speech LLMs are Contextual Reasoning Transcribers
claim: CoT-ASR: speech LLM reasons about context then transcribes; 8.7% rel. WER and 16.9% rel. entity error rate reduction over standard LLM-based ASR.
not_covered: Training contribution; no downstream tool calls, silent-vs-surfaced split, acoustic crossing or confirmation.

title: IndicContextEval: A Benchmark for Evaluating Context Utilisation in Audio Large Language Models Across 8 Indic Languages
claim: 56-h, 555-speaker Indic benchmark with 7-level context prompting incl. adversarial entities; AudioLLM transcribers differ substantially in context utilisation.
not_covered: Transcription with context prompts; no tool calls, numeric-entity arguments or confirmation.

title: Do LLM Decoders Listen Fairly? Benchmarking How Language Model Priors Shape Bias in Speech Recognition
claim: Nine ASR models across CTC/enc-dec/LLM-decoder on ~43k utterances and 12 degradations: Whisper hallucinates on Indian-accented speech and loops under masking, LLM decoders insert 38x less; encoder compression is the lever.
not_covered: Utterance WER/insertions, not entity-level or tool arguments; no telephone band; no confirmation.

title: HalluAudio: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Hallucination Detection in Large Audio-Language Models
claim: 5K+ verified QA pairs over speech/sound/music with adversarial prompts; measures hallucination rate, yes/no bias, refusal across LALMs; grounding deficits.
not_covered: QA hallucination, not spoken-entity transcription into tool arguments; no cascade arm or levers.

title: AudioTrust: Benchmarking the Multifaceted Trustworthiness of Audio Large Language Models
claim: Six trustworthiness dimensions, 26 sub-tasks, 4,420+ real samples; 14 ALLMs; non-semantic cues (timbre, accent, noise) manipulate behaviour.
not_covered: Trust probes, not executed tool calls; no cascade comparison, entity ledger or confirmation.

title: Audio Hallucination Attacks: Probing the Reliability of Large Audio Language Models
claim: AHA-Eval query- and audio-based hallucination attacks; 95.35%/79.65% attack success on Audio Flamingo 3/Gemini 3 Pro; AHA-Guard reduces by up to 49%.
not_covered: Adversarial sound-event hallucination, not benign entity mis-hearing; no tool calls, cascade or confirmation.

title: Walking Through Uncertainty: An Empirical Study of Uncertainty Estimation for Audio-Aware Large Language Models
claim: First systematic uncertainty-estimation study for audio-aware LLMs (5 methods, many settings): semantic/verification methods beat token-level on reasoning; rankings model-dependent on trustworthiness tasks; explores adaptive inference.
not_covered: Uncertainty over QA answers, not tool-argument entities; no ASR-confidence/n-best gating; no clarification calibration; no cascade arm.
